text.description_html:
72 Inch Satin Stainless Steel Ladder Style Door Pull, Back to Back Pair for Glass Doors.

Clean contemporary 72" ladder style door pull handle made of stainless steel. For use on residential and commercial doors such as storefront doors. Warm Satin Stainless Steel finish requires little maintenance and is designed to enhance any setting where a clean contemporary look is desired.

These 72" contemporary ladder style handles feature a nice easy to grip 2" round pull handle that is very comfortable. This item is custom made to order and requires at least 6 week lead time.

Specifications

  • Total Length: 72" (6 feet)
  • Mounting Centers: 60" C/C
  • Pull Projection: 5-3/4"
  • Pull Clearance: 3-3/4"
  • Handle Diameter: 2" Round
  • Material: Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Finishes: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Mounting: Back to back for 1/2" glass

*Sold as a pair (2 door pull handles).
